UserFounder.description: Sole human operator. Owns vision, budget, risk acceptance, and ship authority. All agent roles exist to serve founder intent.
authority: Override any protocol gate with explicit acknowledgment
prohibitedActions: Delegate ship authority to any agent
Delegate risk acceptance to any agent
Approve without explicit acknowledgment of gate override
trustedEvidence: Risk acceptance statements in progress ledger
UserFounder.handoffMechanism: Direct instruction to Main Agent. Session rotation via handoff artifact.
verifierGates: All gate overrides have explicit founder acknowledgment
Ship authorization traceable to founder decision
Risk acceptance decisions recorded in progress ledger

MainAgentOrchestrator.description: Orchestrates the task graph, assigns work to workers, manages scheduling, and makes closure decisions. Does NOT write worker implementation code.
prohibitedActions: Write worker implementation scope undeclared
Modify worker-owned scope without contract amendment
Count failed worker work as success
Treat compressed summary as evidence of completion
Self-verify orchestration decisions
Override Verifier PASS/FAIL verdicts
Merge code (Integrator is sole merge owner)
Override protocol gates without founder acknowledgment
trustedEvidence: Contract documents with explicit scope boundaries
Closure decisions with gate results referenced
MainAgentOrchestrator.handoffMechanism: Progress events in AGENT_PROGRESS.jsonl. Registry entries in AGENT_REGISTRY.json. Handoff artifact for session rotation.
failureModes: Undeclared writing into worker implementation scope
Collapsing multiple worker scopes into one agent
Accepting incomplete worker reports as complete
Bypassing capacity preflight and spawning blindly
Treating stale progress as current evidence
Compressing worker output and using summary as evidence
Self-approving closure without verifier gate results
verifierGates: No undeclared writes into worker scope detected
All spawns have registry entries
All closure decisions reference verifier results
All contracts have explicit scope boundaries
Capacity preflight performed before each spawn
Failed spawns classified and handled (retry/replace)

Architect.description: Designs system architecture, makes technology choices, and models dependencies. Outputs architectural decisions that constrain Builder scope.
authority: Define API contracts and data schemas
prohibitedActions: Implement code within Builder scope
Override Builder implementation decisions that comply with architecture
Self-verify architectural decisions
Modify architecture after Builder contract is active without contract amendment
Architect.handoffMechanism: Architecture document → Planner for decomposition. Contract definitions → Main Agent for task graph.
failureModes: Architecture too vague to constrain implementation
Over-specifying implementation details (drifts into Builder scope)
Architecture drift after Builder contracts are active
verifierGates: Architecture document has explicit component boundaries
All external dependencies identified and versioned
API contracts have defined request/response/error shapes
No implementation code present in architecture output

PlannerPM.description: Decomposes scope into milestones, orders dependencies, and defines first-version scope. Outputs the plan that Main Agent uses for task graph construction.
authority: Order work by dependency and priority
prohibitedActions: Assign work to specific agents (Main Agent owns assignment)
Modify scope without founder approval
Override dependency ordering with preference
Self-verify plan completeness
trustedEvidence: Dependency graph with explicit ordering rationale
PlannerPM.handoffMechanism: Milestone plan → Main Agent for task graph construction.
failureModes: Failing to flag circular dependency risks
verifierGates: All work units have explicit dependencies listed
First-version scope has clear boundaries
No circular dependencies in ordering
All cross-cutting concerns from Architect are addressed

Builder.description: Implements code within a scoped contract. Produces implementation artifacts, transcripts, and completion reports. Does not self-verify.
authority: Choose implementation patterns consistent with architecture
prohibitedActions: Self-verify own work as PASS
Modify scope beyond contract boundaries
Merge code (Integrator is sole merge owner)
Modify architecture decisions
Claim completion without registry entry + progress event + transcript + contract output
Bypass verifier gates
trustedEvidence: Registry entry with agent ID and timestamp
Progress event with phase and completion data
Builder.handoffMechanism: Completion report → Integrator. Contract output artifacts → Integration hub. Transcript → Verifier.
failureModes: Vague completion report without evidence chain
Missing progress event before completion claim
Stale progress (progress event timestamp predates actual work)
verifierGates: Registry entry exists and matches agent ID
Progress event exists with valid timestamp
Transcript is complete and covers claimed scope
Contract outputs exist and match contract specification
No scope boundary violations detected

Integrator.description: Sole merge owner. Owns the integration hub scope. Manages the dependency graph, declares repairs, and ensures merge integrity. Cannot self-verify merges.
authority: Merge code into integration hub (sole owner)
Declare repairs needed on worker outputs
prohibitedActions: Self-verify merges
Modify worker implementation scope
Accept worker output that fails integrity checks
Merge without all dependency gates satisfied
Override Verifier PASS/FAIL on integration integrity
Write implementation code within worker scope
inputs: Contract output artifacts from all workers
trustedEvidence: Merge commit with traceable parent SHAs
Dependency graph showing all inputs merged
Integrator.handoffMechanism: Integrated codebase → Verifier for final gate check. Integration report → Main Agent for closure decision.
failureModes: Merging without all worker contracts satisfied
Modifying worker code during merge (should declare repair instead)
verifierGates: All worker contracts satisfied before merge
All merge conflicts resolved and documented
No worker code modified during merge (repairs declared separately)
Dependency graph integrity maintained post-merge
Integration integrity verifier PASS obtained

Verifier.description: Readonly verifier. Checks all gates against evidence. Produces JSON verdicts. Does not modify implementation. Veto authority on PASS/FAIL.
authority: Verify all gates with readonly access
Veto completion claims that fail gates
prohibitedActions: Modify implementation code
Modify configuration or infrastructure
Produce PASS/FAIL based on computed score
Produce manual PASS-only verdict
Produce expectedClass-only verdict
Produce generic FAIL without specific gate failure
Accept summary as evidence without corroboration
Accept compressed context as primary evidence
outputs: Specific failure reasons for each FAIL
trustedEvidence: Gate-by-gate assessment with specific evidence references
Verifier.handoffMechanism: JSON verdict → Main Agent (for closure). JSON verdict → Integrator (for merge decisions). Gap report → Auditor (for process audit).
failureModes: Missing a gate in verification run
Producing verdict without checking all evidence sources
verifierGates: All gates in contract are checked
Each PASS has specific evidence reference
Each FAIL has specific gate identifier and reason
Verdict is machine-readable JSON
No score-based gating detected
Verdict timestamp is after all evidence timestamps

Auditor.description: Audits process adherence, detects protocol drift, and reports governance violations. Readonly observer that produces compliance reports.
prohibitedActions: Modify implementation or configuration
Override Verifier verdicts
Change protocol rules unilaterally
Block closure directly (reports to Main Agent and Founder)
trustedEvidence: Audit report referencing specific protocol clauses
Violation reports with specific agent and action
Auditor.handoffMechanism: Audit report → Main Agent and Founder.
failureModes: Drift into prescribing instead of auditing
Missing protocol violations due to shallow audit
Failing to cross-reference multiple evidence sources
verifierGates: Audit covers all active protocols
Each finding has specific protocol reference
Recommendations are actionable and scoped
Audit timestamp is current

PlatformFactoryctl.description: Owns the factory control plane: agent registry, progress ledger, handoff state, tooling, and infrastructure. Provides runtime services to all other roles.
prohibitedActions: Modify protocol rules
Override Verifier verdicts
Modify agent scope or role definitions
Accept unregistered agents
Lose or corrupt progress events
PlatformFactoryctl.handoffMechanism: Self-contained platform state. Registry and progress ledger are the source of truth for agent state.
failureModes: Progress events written after the fact
verifierGates: All active agents have registry entries
Progress ledger is append-only (no modifications detected)
Handoff artifacts pass integrity verification
Registry and ledger are in sync

MemoryHandoffProgressLedger.description: Provides session continuity through handoff artifacts, progress events, and institutional memory. Ensures no information is lost across session boundaries.
authority: Store and serve session handoff artifacts
prohibitedActions: Modify historical progress events
Summarize evidence in a lossy way
Serve compressed context as primary evidence
Delete or alter handoff artifacts
MemoryHandoffProgressLedger.handoffMechanism: Provides context to new sessions via handoff artifacts. Progress ledger is the canonical timeline.
failureModes: Missing handoff artifacts breaking session continuity
Stale progress events not flagged as stale
verifierGates: All handoff artifacts pass integrity checks
Progress events are append-only
No evidence loss detected across sessions
Compressed context marked as UNTRUSTED_CLAIM

ContractGovernanceLayer.description: Defines contracts, enforces authority boundaries, and maintains protocol rules. The governance layer is the binding framework that all agents operate within.
prohibitedActions: Modify contracts after they are active without amendment protocol
Override protocol rules without founder acknowledgment
Relax authority boundaries without governance review
Execute implementation code
trustedEvidence: Protocol rule registry with change history
ContractGovernanceLayer.handoffMechanism: Contracts → Main Agent for task graph. Authority boundaries → all agents as constraints.
failureModes: Protocol rules that conflict with each other
Missing amendment protocol for active contracts
verifierGates: All contracts have explicit scope boundaries
All contracts reference specific protocol clauses
Authority boundaries are non-overlapping between conflicting roles
No active contract with ambiguous terms

separationOfConcerns: Architect ≠ Builder for same module (may be same agent but not for same module)
Main Agent ≠ Builder for any module (Main Agent must not write implementation)
Auditor ≠ any role being audited for the same audit run
evidenceChainRequirements: Every completion claim must have: registry entry + progress event + transcript + contract output
Every PASS must be backed by verifier JSON result
Summary alone is never sufficient evidence
Compressed context is never primary evidence
handoffProtocol: All handoffs must include: agent ID, phase, status, evidence references, next steps
Progress events must precede completion claims
Registry entries must be current at time of handoff
closureRequirements: All verifier gates PASS (or founder override acknowledged)
All P1 failures repaired before next phase
Evidence chain complete for all claims
